about.title: We make torches you don't throw away.
about.lede: Shoply was born out of a simple frustration: cheap torches that die in their first winter.
about.p1: Every model starts as a block of aluminium or copper, machined then anodised. LEDs are chosen for their efficiency, not for a number on the box.
about.p2: Batteries can be replaced, and so can the seals. We keep spare parts for every torch sold, because a repaired torch is the greenest one there is.
about.p3: Only three models: that's a choice. Better three perfectly tuned torches than a catalogue of fifty.
